text:
lucy: Heads-up: a few embed requests routed to large model then 413'd. Preflight said OK. noticed payloads around ~550KB.
omar: any sample req_id or headers?
lucy: sample: X-Client-Meta: tier=pro; body ~600KB after JSON. preflight_estimate 480KB.
jay: likely JSON overhead + compression differences. our preflight uses dims*4 heuristic which underestimates for dense JSON arrays.
pat: can we attach estimator_version and preflight_estimate to request metadata so console + runtime can correlate? also a preflight_hash to join traces.
olucy: +1. privacy: only hashed client_id in telemetry, no raw headers.
omar: short-term fix: annotate preflight responses with estimator_version=v0.3 and preflight_estimate_bytes. add telemetry counter preflight_vs_runtime_mismatch.
jay: longer term: runtime shadow-estimate on sampled traffic to compute drift_pct. emit drift histogram. sample 1% initially.
pat: product says no silent splitting by default. prefer explicit 413 with new code embed_oversize_estimate_diff including estimate_bytes, runtime_bytes, request_id and guidance link. opt-in header X-Embed-Client-Behavior=allow_split for partial responses.
lucy: console UX request: show columns estimated / actual (sampled) and a mismatch rate tile. truncate hashed ids to 8 chars.
omar: will add dashboard and alert: mismatch_rate >0.5% or >500/day.
ingest-bot: deploy 1715200045 by omar: preflight annotate + telemetry counter -> staging
jay: once staging looks good, run 2h prod-canary with sample_rate=5% for shadow estimator.
lucy: noted. assigning followups: omar (deploy + dashboard), jay (shadow estimator + telemetry), pat (error schema + SDK guidance).
